response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), overall AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, AVG(race_count) AS average_race_count FROM circuit_counts) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / o.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 * (c.race_count - o.average_race_count) / o.total_races AS share_above_average FROM circuit_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.race_count > o.average_race_count ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, c.circuitId LIMIT 10;
